title: Accessibility Statement | PressCosmos
description: PressCosmos is built to WCAG 2.2 AA: keyboard navigation, reduced-motion support, contrast targets and our known limitations.

Legal

Accessibility Statement

A press release service that some journalists cannot read is a broken press release service.

Template notice This page is a working template written for the PressCosmos launch build. It is drafted to be accurate and readable, but it is not legal advice. Have your counsel review it against the jurisdictions you operate in before you rely on it commercially. Last reviewed: 2026-10-30.

1. Our commitment

We aim to meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA across the public site, the newsroom and the submission flow. Accessibility is treated as a release requirement, not a backlog item.

2. What we have implemented

  • Semantic HTML landmarks, one h1 per page, and a valid heading hierarchy
  • Full keyboard operation, including skip links and visible focus indicators
  • Respect for prefers-reduced-motion — every animation is disabled, not merely shortened
  • Contrast targets of 4.5:1 for body text and 3:1 for large text and interface components
  • A dark theme and a light theme, both contrast-checked independently
  • Text that scales to 200% without loss of content or function
  • Colour never used as the only means of conveying information
  • Descriptive alt text on meaningful images and empty alt on decorative ones
  • Labelled form fields with associated error messaging and aria-live status regions

3. Known limitations

Honest list of what we know is not finished: the interactive coverage map relies on a canvas-based library that is not fully screen-reader navigable, and we publish a table alternative alongside it. Some third-party embeds in submitted releases are outside our control and may not be accessible — we flag these to submitters.

4. How we test

Automated checks in the build pipeline on every deployment, manual keyboard and screen-reader testing on each major release, and an annual third-party audit. Testing covers NVDA with Firefox and VoiceOver with Safari.

5. Feedback and enforcement

If you encounter a barrier, email support@presscosmos.com. We acknowledge within two business days and aim to resolve or provide an accessible alternative within ten. If you are not satisfied with our response, you can escalate your complaint to your national accessibility enforcement body.

6. Alternative formats

Any published release can be provided as a plain-text document on request, and our editors will describe charts or data visualisations in words if you need them for assistive technology or print.

Questions about this policy? Write to support@presscosmos.com or post to PressCosmos Media Network, 2261 Market Street, Suite 4800, San Francisco, CA 94114, US.
